productionBaselineEvidence: Main c353099a67439f3fe666ee231003c5b6df0ca4f3 contains the cumulative AdMob startup, UMP consent, NativeAd-first, sequential BannerAd fallback, request reservation, empty-slot collapse, Public/Organization/Cluster isolation, interstitial cadence, and dedicated Public Wall entry placement fixes. Existing PR checks passed; the production OTA workflow previously ran TypeScript and general release anchors but did not execute the focused AdMob suite before freezing/publishing the RC.
chosenApproach: Add the existing focused Node regression tests for all current AdMob runtime gates to the manual Android production OTA workflow immediately after TypeScript QA. Keep the existing DEV PR gates, production baseline check, exact frozen RC hashing, native runtime restrictions, EAS publication and live bundle verification unchanged.
selectionRationale: The test files already run under Node 22 and passed the relevant DEV CI suites. Running them again on the exact main commit before RC export closes the gap between PR validation and production promotion without adding SDK requests, native dependencies, build steps or production mutations.

Use one release-focused Node regression test that verifies workflow placement and executes the canonical eleven-file suite; selected.
